statement: Among adults in the economies where the 2024 Global Findex borrowing / digital-payment module was administered, digital-payment activity is positively associated with borrowing from a formal financial institution, and this association is larger in economies that had lower 2019 credit-information coverage.
mechanism_hypothesised: Descriptive expectation (NOT identified): where 2019 credit-bureau/registry coverage was lower, lenders had fewer borrower credit files, so a digital-payment footprint (especially payments RECEIVED into an account) may be more visible as a signal; hence the within-economy payment-borrowing slope may be steeper where 2019 coverage was lower. Individual-level descriptive analogue of Galilea, Farazi & Mare (2026), 'Firm Credit Constraints and Electronic Payments: A Global Analysis' (firm level, 101 economies).
outcome: formal_borrow = 1 if fin22a == 1 (borrowed from a bank or similar formal financial institution in past 12 months), 0 if fin22a == 2; drop DK/refused
key_regressor: anydigpayment (made or received a digital payment in past 12 months); mechanism split into receive_dig (received into an account) vs make_dig
moderator: lowcov2019_z = negative z-score of any_cov = max(2019 private credit-bureau coverage %, 2019 public credit-registry coverage %), archived World Bank Doing Business series (measures COVERAGE, not quality or lender use; vintage 2019). Robustness proxies: lowdepth2019_z (2019 depth-of-credit-information index 0-8), lowrights2019_z (2019 strength-of-legal-rights index 0-12).
data: data/raw/wb_credit_information_latest_snapshot.csv (World Bank Doing Business archived indicators, 2019 snapshot; sha256 ef0c67f9c7d44b67939e088f0aab2e578f7ba0d7f2eeadc4093c0103cc1bd06c)
analysis_sample: module-administered economies with complete primary covariates; ~97 economies expected (Lesotho excluded: inc_q entirely missing; China retained); ~100k adults; 6 High-income economies retained in primary, excluded in robustness M6.3; moderator merged by ISO3 at 100%. Exact drop table reported by Codex in Stage 1.
realized_sample: 100,560 adults in 97 economies (Stage 1, CODEX-S5-BUILD-20260909-001); M3 mechanism frame 90,118 in 89 economies.

decision_rules.supported: b3 > 0 and significant at 5% (economy-clustered), robust to M2b (below-median moderator), M2c (bureau/registry joint), M6.1 (weighting), M6.3 (drop 6 high-income), M6.4 (depth/rights proxies), M6.5 (country controls lgdppc + privcredit_gdp + acct_own_rate and their interactions with anydigpayment); and M3b shows g3 > 0
decision_rules.not_supported: b3 ~ 0 or negative, or b3 loses significance / flips sign under M6.5, or b3 is driven by fewer than 5 economies (M6.9 leave-one-economy-out)
decision_rules.reporting: report the estimate and its sign regardless of outcome; a null interaction is a valid, reportable result; no specification outside PREREGISTRATION.md is confirmatory

verdict.conjunct_1_positive_association: SUPPORTED_AS_DESCRIPTIVE (M1 b1 = +0.03617, economy-clustered SE 0.00514, p < 1e-9; within-economy association only, non-causal) -> evidence E-000068
verdict.conjunct_2_moderation_larger_where_cover: FALSIFIED (M2 b3 = -0.01975, economy-clustered SE 0.00474, p = 6.8e-5; OPPOSITE the hypothesised sign; robust to M2b, M6.1, M6.3, M6.5, M6.6, M6.8, M6.10, all 7 leave-one-region-out and all 97 leave-one-economy-out fits; logit/probit interaction AME also negative. NOTE per SELFREVIEW-20260910T051500Z C9: the M6.4 alternative moderator proxies do NOT reproduce a significant negative -- depth proxy -0.0053 p~0.18, legal-rights proxy +0.0070 p~0.24 -- so the significant reversal is specific to the registered 2019 coverage moderator, not a generic weak-institutions gradient) -> counter-evidence E-000069
verdict.mechanism_C3: FALSIFIED (M3a make 0.05172 > receive 0.04080, contra g1 > g2; M3b receive interaction -0.0027 ns, make interaction -0.0202)
verdict.placebo_C4: FALSIFIED (informal_borrow interaction = +0.01736, p = 0.005; not null and wrong direction for a credit-information-substitution reading)
verdict.reopening: allowed per autonomy.research.allow_reopen_rejected_hypothesis; would require a new pre-registered design (e.g. panel data, a contemporaneous 2024 coverage measure, or lender-level information use).

tests_required: EXP-S5-001 (primary + moderation + mechanism + robustness, per PREREGISTRATION.md)
reproduction_status: INDEPENDENTLY_REPRODUCED (CLAUDE-S5R-20260910-001, 2026-09-10; PASS; 41 of 44 compared quantities exact-match to |delta| < 5e-13; 3 rows across 2 non-primary diagnostics differ non-materially (M2c Wald form; logit+probit interaction AMEs); count corrected 2026-09-10 to match comparison.csv, was '43/45'; see audit/CLAUDE_S5_STAGE4_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION.md and research_council/reports/TABLEAUDIT-20260910T045000Z-claude.json D1)

Codex ran Stage 1 (build: 100,560 adults / 97 economies), Stage 2 (EXP-S5-001, all specifications M1-M7 + T1-T6 + F1-F3) and Stage 3 (adversarial audit). Verdict: H-000500 NOT SUPPORTED - the moderation interaction b3 = -0.01975 (economy-clustered SE 0.00474, p = 6.8e-5) carries the OPPOSITE sign to the hypothesis and survives every robustness branch and every adversarial attack with that sign. C1 supported as a within-economy descriptive association only (M1 b1 = +0.03617). C3 (receive > make) and C4 (informal-borrow placebo) also fail. All results ESTIMATED_UNVERIFIED pending independent reproduction.

revision_history.decision_rule: PREREGISTRATION.md section 6 not_supported branch (frozen pre-estimation): 'b3 ~ 0 or negative' -> not supported. Result lands squarely in this branch: b3 significantly negative, robust.
revision_history.note: Stage 4 independent reproduction by Claude (audit/CLAUDE_S5_STAGE4_INDEPENDENT_REPRODUCTION.md, run CLAUDE-S5R-20260910-001): cold re-implementation, no Codex code read, frozen-contract and raw-input hashes re-verified. 43 of 45 comparable quantities reproduce to |delta| < 5e-13, including M1 b1, M2 b3, M2b, M3a/M3b, all M4, the full M6 grid, and every Stage-3 adversarial check; the 97-fit leave-one-economy-out set is all-negative. Two non-primary diagnostics differ non-materially (M2c Wald statistic form; M6.2 non-linear interaction AME magnitude ~11%, same sign). Verdict PASS. LPM evidence status ESTIMATED_UNVERIFIED -> INDEPENDENTLY_REPRODUCED. Both agents concur; no dissent recorded. H-000500 is REJECTED as a ledger state under the frozen decision rule (not a claim of disproof); the distinctive contribution - the moderation - is falsified with the opposite sign. The positive within-economy association (conjunct 1) stands separately as a descriptive, non-causal finding and is the honest basis for the UEH competition manuscript. Reopening permitted with a new pre-registered design. Study 1 untouched.
